title: Adjusting Repulsion Gain
statement: Adjusting the repulsion gain parameter will help the robot navigate more efficiently around obstacles, potentially reducing the time spent in collision avoidance maneuvers and thus optimizing navigation speed.
mechanism: By fine-tuning the repulsion gain, the robot can better balance between avoiding obstacles and maintaining its intended path, which could lead to a more direct and faster route to the goal.
